quizzes_scope_check.name: quizzes_scope_check
quizzes_scope_check.value: ("quizzes"."challenge_id" is not null and "quizzes"."coverage" in ('challenge', 'related', 'mixed')) or ("quizzes"."challenge_id" is null and "quizzes"."coverage" = 'topic' and "quizzes"."topic" is not null and "quizzes"."difficulty" is not null)
